title: Alternating Chemicals to Prevent Mosquitoes Developing Immunity against Repellents
what_it_is: Alternating Chemicals to Prevent Mosquitoes Developing Immunity against Repellents

sections.label: Mosquito control and fogging
sections.summary: Source reduction is the most effective method to reduce mosquitoes, though targeted fogging may be needed for urgent large populations, with NEA monitoring insecticide resistance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Source reduction, or eliminating potential mosquito breeding habitats, is the most effective method to reduce the mosquito population.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: It is much easier to detect and kill mosquitos at the larval stage than to undertake fogging to try to eliminate them after they hatch.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, fogging may still be necessary as a complementary approach when there is urgency to reduce a large mosquito population, such as in areas where there is active dengue transmission.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) does not practise the alternating of chemicals used in fogging as a standard procedure.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Instead, fogging is carried out in a selective and targeted manner to avoid the build-up of resistance in the mosquito population.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: As an additional safeguard, NEA regularly monitors the resistance of mosquitoes against insecticides to ensure that the insecticides used are effective.
